The '''Monster Fireplace''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that can be purchased from [[Krobus]]' shop for {{Price|20000}}.  

[[Furniture#Fireplaces|Fireplaces]] cannot be placed outside. Once placed, right-clicking on it will turn the fire on or off.

==History==
{{History|1.3.27|Introduced.}}
